method: Exact Fraction intervals and bounded-series exp/log
validation_scope: Conditional full hybrid forward invariance; training entry observed numerically, not interval-replayed
parameter_half_width: 1e-8 for noncapped gains; exact mechanical stop at4
gain_actuators: Currents physically blocked or mechanical stop; never disabled by test protocol
recovery_actuator: May remain active; b stays in [.08,1.1] without changing emission profile or readiness
monitor: Every local cycle returns to .025 before next local pulse
mixing_scope: After the first protected return: principal ready charge is exactly r, so timing Jacobians are stochastic; initial +/-1e-10 charges are covered for entry-wave fidelity and invariance, not for exact stochasticity
conclusion: For source spacing>=20 the entry tube is preserved and its first wave is bounded. After one protected return, subsequent pulses have fixed delays and certified finite mixing. Exact relative timing from the first pulse additionally requires exact initial principal rest charges
unclosed: A validated interval replay of the complete 128-pulse learning transient from the initial state
